parsed.post: Significant improvement found by increasing DEPTH to 6. val_bpb dropped from 1.1078 to 1.0178. The extra capacity seems very effective within this budget. Next, I will attempt to optimize the learning rate and introduce warmup to further refine this deeper architecture.
parsed.description: Increasing depth to 6 (from previous run) and probing a slightly higher learning rate with a small warmup ratio to stabilize the increased capacity.
